# Nets Unlimited, Inc.

> Nets Unlimited designs, fabricates and installs custom rope, cable and netting systems for commercial, recreational and zoological environments.

Nets Unlimited, Inc. is a licensed, bonded and insured netting specialist founded in 2004 and based in Phoenix, Arizona. The company serves clients across the United States.

## Primary services

- Custom design and project planning
- Rope and net fabrication
- Professional installation
- Inspection and maintenance

## Applications

- Zoo and aquarium enclosures and animal enrichment
- Waterpark and theme-park barriers and dry play
- Rope bridges, tunnels and play elements
- Rope, cable and stainless-steel handrails
- Golf and sports containment netting
- Fall, debris and secondary protection netting
- Architectural rope and net decor
